adopt.pattern: Persistent cost-per-minute header with a component bar on every builder tab, plus a price table showing component, cents, pulse and the models inside the flat price
adopt.evidence: WT report s11, s13, [25][26]; screenshots 01, 16, 34, 35: 3.5 + 0.5 + 2 = 6 cents, 30 s pulse, 38 included chips. Observed.
adopt.why: Best price transparency of the six dashboards (WS best-in-class). VP extends it to INR, GST, and latency per option (must-be A).

adopt.pattern: Per-language chips that carry their own prompt, voice and transcriber, plus a sectioned prompt canvas with token counter and {{var}} / @ / # insertion
adopt.why: Right shape for Hindi, English and regional variants of one agent; the token counter is the visible side of VP's prompt-budget law. Pair with a lint, which Bolna lacks.

adopt.pattern: Barge-in recovery set: sequence-id audio gate, history trimmed to what the caller heard (mark echoes), merge of unheard user turns with a 0.7 s settle, duplicate-reply block, barge-in deferred during tool calls
adopt.evidence: AP report s1.10, s5, s6 (code at bc59921, task_manager.py / interruption_manager.py); AS s3 notes closed vendors likely do the same. Observed in code.
adopt.why: Prevents the agent from remembering things the caller never heard; cheap to port and independent of the reply-gap policy. VP must still replace the fixed 900 ms hold and the discard rule.

adopt.pattern: Language switching by parallel unbiased language-ID stream plus a judge, pre-warmed per-language STT, handoff clip, and the rule that a number readout never triggers a switch
adopt.evidence: AP s1.4; evidence.2026-10-20.acct-bolna-language-switch; BI-06 and calibration.md. Observed in code.
adopt.why: Proven recipe for the hard failure that Indian buyers report ('agent not switching language', 20 posts, L4A s6). Use as the in-doubt fallback behind one code-mixed register, not as the default path.

adopt.pattern: Auto-created, prompt-tailored, Hinglish-aware outcome judges at agent creation (success / completion), run by a cheap model
adopt.evidence: AP s1.5, ACB-12/13: two gpt-4.1-mini dispositions appeared 5 s and 25 s after create, free, hidden. Observed via our API.
adopt.why: Outcome analytics with zero setup is the right default. VP makes them visible, editable in chat, graded against verified keys, and wired to the v2 learning loop.

adopt.pattern: Row-level import failure codes (invalid_phone, missing_required_value, duplicate_reference_id, empty_row, invalid_field_type), corrective re-upload, and +91 default for bare numbers
adopt.evidence: AP s1.7, ACB-19/20 (workflow campaign schema; vendor-claimed grade on ACB-19, dashboard upload not exercised).
adopt.why: Matches must-be CSV hygiene (W2). VP also dedupes on E.164 and applies opt-out/DND per row, which Bolna lacks.

adopt.pattern: Rich typed execution record: cost_breakdown lines, hangup_by/reason/provider_code, ring_duration, post_dial_delay, carrier, raw per-component log, per-turn progression, 12 hangup_detail codes
adopt.evidence: AP s3, s7, ACB-21/22. Observed in API schema and code.
adopt.why: Raw material for failure explainability (W6) and learning. VP adds a business-language reason and an action on top of the engineering code.

adopt.pattern: Live events API into a running call, and graph event edges that route on those events
adopt.evidence: AP s7: POST /v1/call/{run_id}/events; graph agents route on event edges. Observed in code and docs.
adopt.why: Lets CRM, payment or WhatsApp events change a live call, which VP's agenda ledger needs for relational calls.

adopt.pattern: UI contract patterns: dependent fields disabled with a reason, workflow nodes whose descriptions state their contract, definitional empty states with one CTA, SIP trunk Health / Active calls / Last call, API and MCP buttons beside every list page, webhook Send test beside config
adopt.why: Cheap, high-value usability moves VP can match on day one; they feed must-be D (a reason on every disabled action).

adopt.pattern: Developer surface as product: Bearer API, CLI, MCP server listed as a Claude connector, 20 Skills, AGENTS.md and llms.txt, Ask Bolna that reads and writes account state
adopt.evidence: TD report s1 (BOL-02), WT [41]; AP s11. Observed.
adopt.why: Chat setup is parity, not a wedge (5 of 6 vendors ship a copilot, WS finding 8). VP matches it and wins on what the chat sets up (compliance, judges, tests).

adopt.pattern: LLM overflow failover and typed component errors that hang up cleanly with a reason code
adopt.evidence: AP s1.8, s5; hangup_detail list; evidence.2026-10-20.acct-bolna-llm-overflow. Observed in code.
adopt.why: Good base for VP's disclosed same-voice fallback policy; extend to STT, TTS and carrier with an active breaker.

adopt.pattern: Telephony trust surface: Truecaller verification per number, BYO carrier presets via SIP trunk, India-routing label, Indian-numbers-first KYC that states required documents before the click
adopt.why: Answered-rate and first-ring speed are India-specific differentiators; VP shows the gate as a checklist before any credential is asked (W7).

beat.gap: Reply gap is invisible and structurally slow: 500 ms endpointing plus a 900 ms output hold gives a floor of about 1.4 s, with no predicted gap in the UI
beat.how_vp_beats: Pause-aware release instead of a fixed hold, a predicted reply gap shown beside the turn controls, plain-language presets. Test: stereo PSTN battery on an Indian handset, 30+ clean turns per vendor. Pass: VP p50 at least 0.3 s below Bolna, p90 2.5 s or less, cut-ins 5% or less (W3). Caveat: Bolna's floor is inferred, not measured, and VP's own turn-taking is unsolved (15-42% cut-ins, open.2026-10-19.turn-taking).

beat.gap: Short Hindi replies spoken over the agent are discarded (final of 1 word or fewer not on an English exact-match stop list); speech during the welcome is dropped; stop and filler lists are English-only
beat.how_vp_beats: Classify every short reply as acknowledgement, objection or stop with a Hinglish lexicon; never discard; listen during the opening. Test: 4 short Hindi replies (haan, nahi, ruko, bas) said over the agent plus barge turns. Pass: VP 90% or more handled and stops within 600 ms; kill if VP is not above the incumbent median (W4, risk.2026-10-20.acct-synthesis-turn-taking-beat-unproven).
beat.evidence: AP s1.3, ACB-35; calibration.md; WT [35][36] (welcome toggle OFF by default needs a condition)

beat.gap: Compliance is reactive: guardrails off by default and whole-hour only, no NCPR/DND scrub, consent only as proof after a violation report, wrong 9-21 window, no consent/DND/contact objects, no compliance field on the campaign or batch form
beat.how_vp_beats: Compliance on by default as campaign and contact fields: category-aware windows (10:00-21:00 promotional), NCPR/DND suppression on every path, consent ledger, AI disclosure, series routing. Test T2: messy CSV with an opt-out row and a DND number, rings on those rows must be 0, opt-out carried to a second campaign (T9b). Pass: VP 0 and 0 against an incumbent median of 1 or more (W1).
beat.evidence: BOL-44..48, ACB-20, WT s9 [48][49], TS W1; calibration (0 India compliance lines in the engine)

beat.gap: Two overlapping outbound systems (Batches report only counts; Campaigns need a published workflow and are Beta); no contact object; dedupe by reference_id, not phone
beat.how_vp_beats: One contact-centric campaign from a contact list and an agent, no mandatory workflow, no Beta label; E.164 normalise and dedupe on phone; contacts carry DND status, attempt history and a reserved memory slot (must-be B). Test: 50-row messy CSV, count duplicates dialled, per-row reasons shown, minutes from upload to correct 'valid' count.
beat.evidence: ACB-19/20/21, WT s9 [46][47], WS must-be B

beat.gap: No price or latency in any picker; non-preferred models silently leave the flat rate; USD wallet and invoices with mixed cents/dollars/rupees; 30 s pulse makes a 5 s no-answer cost about INR 2.9; displayed floor INR 4.30 vs VP ambition about INR 2
beat.how_vp_beats: INR with GST everywhere; measured India p50 first-audio and rupee cost on every stack option; one all-in INR per connected minute including telephony, pulse and turn wait; per-second or very short stated pulse; pre-launch campaign cost estimate; spend caps. Test: time for a buyer to pick a stack that meets a stated price and gap target; cost of a 5 s voicemail call. Needs a cheaper default stack, since Bolna's COGS is INR 2.0-3.8 and it can follow a discount (rejected.2026-10-17.parity-undercut).

beat.gap: Outcome judges are hidden, vendor-owned and not connected to anything; no experiments, no customer learning loop; no cross-call memory or contact entity
beat.how_vp_beats: Visible, editable judges set up in chat and graded against verified keys (a model never grades itself), feeding the v2 learning loop with honest statistics; consented, editable contact memory across calls that feeds the agenda ledger (no raw-fact memory, rejected.2026-10-20.raw-fact-memory). Test: judge agreement with human-verified outcomes; share of second calls that correctly use first-call context.

beat.gap: Failure explainability is thin and carriers are single-homed: 9 of 18 incidents are upstream Indian telephony, no carrier failover, STT/TTS only reconnect, circuit breaker in shadow mode, debugging is an execution-ID search
beat.how_vp_beats: Dual-carrier routing with an active breaker, a disclosed same-voice fallback, and a failed-call view that shows a business-language reason, the carrier code and an action. Test T5: five induced failures. Pass: each found in under 60 s, 5 of 5 correct, 4 or more actionable (W6).
beat.evidence: BOL-40, AP s1.8, WT s10; ACB-14 (undocumented 'prepared' status)

beat.gap: Testing is a phone call to a verified number only: no in-builder browser voice or text test, no simulation or eval surface, no unsaved-state marker or version visibility; India number gate shown as an error after country selection
beat.how_vp_beats: Docked browser voice and text test needing no KYC, simulated-caller tests in the builder, unsaved marker and version diff, and a pre-flight checklist for the Indian number path (documents, series, price, time). Test T0/W7: minutes from sign-up to first ring on an Indian handset. Pass: VP 15 min or less on a BYO or pre-provisioned number; kill if Bolna or Sarvam does it in 20 min or less (person-KYC makes that more plausible).
beat.evidence: WT s2, s7, s8 [40][53], WS must-be D and item 1; TS W7, W10

beat.gap: Hinglish is handled by a whole-stack language swap with a judge call, 22 language options but no Hinglish or code-mixed mode, an unexplained 'India Multilingual', and a voice list with no language field and romance voices
beat.how_vp_beats: A single code-mixed register (code-mixed STT plus TTS that speaks mixed script), the judge only when in doubt; voice picker filtered by language and register with counts, no romance voices in business catalogues. Test (W5): language hold of 80% or more on Hinglish turns and no English replies after a full switch to Hindi (TP-019/020), judged by ear as well as by metric (rejected.harvest.09).

beat.gap: Voicemail detection is a transcript classifier that waits for 7+ words and checks every 7 s for up to 30 s (billed meanwhile), with no Hindi or regional operator messages
beat.how_vp_beats: An Indian operator-message lexicon in about 10 languages with early exit and a reason code, so a switched-off or voicemail call ends in seconds. Test: 5 calls to numbers that play Hindi operator or IVR messages (TP-011); compare detection time and billed seconds. Needs a call lab; not yet run.

beat.gap: Trust and operations: 4 of 4 Trustpilot reviews are 1 star about unanswered demos, refunds and refused pilots; webhooks unsigned; docs and server defaults disagree; unknown API fields silently dropped; no published OpenAPI file; fee and pulse confusion
beat.how_vp_beats: Human support in Indian business hours with a first-reply target under 2 h, one transparent fee line, HMAC-signed webhooks, a spec-first API that returns 422 on unknown fields and supports idempotency keys, and a tested stored-config equals running-config guarantee. Test T8: one real setup question filed at 11:00 IST on a weekday (Bolna P13 predicts over 24 h); test W10 by diffing an API-created agent against what was sent. Support is an operating promise, not product.
beat.evidence: TD s7, R2 s3.2, BOL-14, ACB (api drift), AS s2; TS W9, W10; TP-022

beat.gap: Warm transfer and live-call context are weak: transfer POSTs no summary after a fixed 2 s sleep, so the human receives a cold call
beat.how_vp_beats: Warm hand-off with a spoken-quality summary and the agenda-ledger state delivered to the human before connect; transfer reason recorded as an outcome. Test: listen on the receiving handset in the call battery (TP-013); score completeness of context received.
